item.title: Jellify v1.2.10
item.description:
Jellify 1.2.10 | Jellify-1.2.10
Welcome to Jellify 1.2.10
Hey music lovers! I've polished up some underlying bits and have made a key fix to boost stability across the board. Get ready for an even smoother listening experience when you’re exploring your Jellyfin collection!
* **Android Crash Fixes:** We detected and patched out a crash that was occurring on Android devices, so you can now enjoy uninterrupted music playback no matter how deep you dive into your library. * **Optimized Performance:** Several dependency updates have been implemented behind the scenes to enhance overall app performance and make navigation feel snappier than ever before. * **App General Polish:** We've made various quality-of-life improvements in various components, ensuring Jellify remains robust and reliable for years of listening fun!
